people.name: Ahab
people.line: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel

people.name: Jehu
people.line: Son of Jehoshaphat, king of Israel, destroyed Ahab's dynasty.

translations.web: Jehu gathered all the people together, and said to them, “Ahab served Baal a little; but Jehu will serve him much.
translations.bsb: Then Jehu brought all the people together and said, “Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him a lot.
